Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) to identify interactors of CCAR1L and CCAR1S. While the broader paper discusses acetylation and ubiquitylation of SRSF5, the specific LC-MS/MS dataset (PXD009266) described in the methods and PRIDE metadata is focused on the CCAR1 interactome using DDA and label-free identification. The variable modifications listed in the search parameters are standard (N-term acetyl, Met oxidation) and not specific PTM-enrichment modifiers.

scope: Distinct isoforms of CCAR1 were immunoprecipitated with Protein A-G agarose from A549 cells stably expressing Flag-CCAR1L and Flag-CCAR1S with endogenous CCAR1L/S depleted.
we purified CCAR1L and CCAR1S from flag-CCAR1L or CCAR1S overexpressing A549 cells by performing IP-MS to screening the possible proteins which are specifically interacting with CCAR1L or CCAR1S.
